## Welcome to the DAPR2 labs!

::::{.columns}
:::{.column style="font-size:.6em; width:55%"}

1. Sit down anywhere you like.
2. Introduce yourself to your neighbours.
3. Fill in this (incredibly brief) attendance form &#8594;
4. Open up RStudio and find the lab exercises on Learn.
5. Start working through the exercises.
    - **Elizabeth,** along with wonderful tutors **Artemis, Hong, Lara, and Nicola,** are here to help!
    - If you don't get through all the exercises during the lab, please finish them up at home.
    - You can check your work against the solutions, which will be posted every Friday.
